bias.en: Downtrend · SAR flipped bearish, near the Nov 5 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · SAR 翻空，接近 11月5日低点

read.en: ASML fell 1.7% on Nov 17 to $1,383.11, trading $1,351.78–1,408.18 on volume 1.4 times the 20-day average. It is below the 5-day ($1,463.3), 10-day ($1,461.5), 30-day ($1,589.5), 100-day ($1,698.8) and 200-day ($1,601.8). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 17 ($1,563.46), and RSI is 34.8.

The low broke the $1,382.5 SAR, flipping it bearish, and dipped under the Nov 5 low ($1,355.05) before the close recovered. Resistance is $1,404–1,409 (Nov 16 and 6 lows, Nov 17 high), then $1,425–1,447.5 and $1,461.5–1,463.3 (10 and 5-day). Support is $1,351.8–1,356.7 (Nov 17 and 5 lows, Nov 5 close), then the round $1,300. A close above $1,409 would target $1,425–1,447; below $1,351.8, $1,300.
